landing.heroSubhead: An immutable check-in/out ledger. Passkeys, QR and kiosk flows make entry effortless; server-authoritative time and a tamper-evident audit trail make the record impossible to quietly rewrite.
landing.visitorPrompt: Here to check in? Point your phone's camera at the QR code posted at your location — it opens your check-in directly.
landing.visitorScanLink: If it doesn't open, scan it here
landing.pairingHeading: Frictionless at the door. Certain in the record.
landing.pairingSubhead: Most systems trade one for the other — a fast turnstile with a soft log, or a rigorous log nobody wants to use. The same event is both here, and that pairing is the whole product.
landing.qrDetail: Printed room codes or live kiosk
landing.footerTagline: Secure check-in logging · Immutable by design

login.subhead: Staff and admin access to the console.
login.authSubhead: Sign in to manage locations, audit the ledger, and invite your team.
login.reasonSignedOutOthersTitle: Every other session on this account has ended.
login.reasonSignedOutOthersBody: Sign in again to continue on this device. Every browser and phone with an old cookie will land here on its next request — usually within a minute of you pressing the button.
login.reasonSessionExpiredTitle: You've been signed out on this device.
login.reasonSessionExpiredBody: Your session ended — either the 14-day sign-in expired or someone on this account ended every session. Sign back in to continue.
login.reasonSessionRevokedBody: The session on this device was revoked from Settings → Security. If that wasn't you, sign in and end every session immediately.
login.errorTooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
login.errorNoMatch: That email and password do not match an account.
login.errorRateLimited429: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
login.errorRequestLinkFailed: Could not request a new link just now. Try again in a moment.
login.errorEnterEmailFirst: Enter your email address first, then sign in with your passkey.
login.errorNoPasskeyRegistered: No passkey is registered for this account.
login.errorPasskeyVerifyFailed: That passkey could not be verified.
login.errorPasskeySignInFailed: Passkey sign-in failed. Try your password instead.
login.noPasswordYetTitle: This account has no password yet
login.noPasswordYetBodyAdmin: An administrator created it for you. Set a password to sign in.
login.linkOnWayTo: A link to set your password is on its way to {email}.
login.verifyEmailTitle: Verify your email before signing in
login.newVerificationOnWay: A new verification link is on its way to {email}.
